name: this_week
sql: SELECT skill, count() AS n FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(Skills) AS skill FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= subtractDays(now(), 7)) GROUP BY skill

name: prior_week
sql: SELECT skill, count() AS n FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(Skills) AS skill FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= subtractDays(now(), 14) AND StartedAt < subtractDays(now(), 7)) GROUP BY skill
